text:
maya: Hi all — first day, trying to get dev env working on mac M1. asdf plugin-add keeps failing with "curl: (60) SSL: certificate signed by unknown authority". Anybody hit this behind our corp VPN? :wave:
owen: Welcome! Yup, corp intercepting proxy is usually the cause. Quick fixes: 1) get the corp root CA and add to mac system keychain, 2) run a local proxy (cntlm/tinyproxy) and point env vars to it, 3) ensure both uppercase and lowercase HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY are exported.

kevin: For the CA: put the .crt on your machine then `sudo security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain corp-root.crt`. After that restart any shells and try again.

maya: how do I add the proxy envs so VS Code terminal and GUI apps see them? mine only works in Terminal.app.
owen: For VS Code on mac, launch it from the terminal (`code .`) so it inherits your env. Alternatively set env in /etc/paths.d or create a launch agent that sets env for GUI apps. We also add `export HTTP_PROXY=...` to ~/.zprofile and `~/.zshrc` to cover login/non-login shells.

kevin: asdf-nodejs also wants GPG keys. After fixing TLS, run `~/.asdf/plugins/nodejs/bin/import-release-team-keyring` as the plugin docs say. Make sure gpg is installed: `brew install gnupg`.
